name: rig-works
description: Rig: an empty JS plugin host (kernel + backend/frontend plugins)

scripts.build: npm run build:type && npm run build:bundle
scripts.build:type: npm run build:type --workspaces --if-present && bun run scripts/types-package.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/plugin --noEmit --composite false --incremental false && tsc -p tsconfig.plugins.json
